prompt_prefix: whimsical storybook illustration, Ghibli-adjacent warmth, soft rounded forms, inviting colors, children's book quality, gentle wonder, cozy fantasy
prompt_suffix: no text, no watermarks, heartwarming quality, masterful children's illustration, gentle and inviting
negative_prompt: dark, gritty, horror, violent, scary, photographic, harsh shadows, desaturated, adult themes, sharp edges, threatening

mood_modifiers.tense: gentle tension, storm clouds with silver linings, worried but hopeful expressions
mood_modifiers.joyful: celebration colors, warm golden light, characters mid-laugh, pure happiness
mood_modifiers.eerie: gentle mystery, friendly shadows, curious rather than scary, wonderment at unknown
mood_modifiers.epic: grand adventure scale, but friendly, heroes small against beautiful vastness
mood_modifiers.peaceful: cozy interiors, warm hearth light, tea and comfort, safe haven
mood_modifiers.melancholy: gentle sadness, autumn leaves, goodbyes that promise return, bittersweet beauty
mood_modifiers.awe: wonder at nature or magic, childlike amazement, beautiful discovery
mood_modifiers.dread: worry for friends, gentle stakes, concern without terror, solvable problems

scene.wide: storybook landscape, rolling hills, friendly architecture, paths inviting exploration
scene.medium: character in cozy environment, warm details, lived-in spaces
scene.close: character expression focus, emotive and readable, gentle features
scene.low_angle: looking up at friendly giant or tree, wonder not fear
scene.overhead: map-like storybook view, locations as destinations for adventure
scene.default: classic illustration composition, character journey implied, welcoming world

portrait.default: friendly character portrait, expressive eyes, approachable design, warmth in expression

location_card.default: welcoming location establishing shot, path leading in, lights in windows, adventure awaits

item.default: magical item with gentle glow, friendly design, storybook prop quality

moment.default: heartwarming action, friends helping friends, gentle triumph, emotional climax
